text: Planning an outdoor festival. First, the food stalls: bundle Food1, Food2 and Food3 into a group called Eats. Then make a group named Music out of Stage and Dj. The Bar should be near Eats. Put Music at the top and then Eats below Music. Tent can sit between Music and Eats. Duplicate Eats, we need two food courts. And is the Bar in a group? I don't think so.

uh so I have five samples and I'd like to bundle Sample1, Sample2, Sample3, Sample4 and Sample5 into one group called Samples. Then arrange Samples in a row and align Samples vertically? no, horizontally. The Scope goes above Samples. How many groups do we have, just the one right?
Combine Ceo, Cfo, Coo and Cto into a group named Board. Pa sits below Board. Make Board gold, it's the board after all.
bundle Sun, Moon and Star into Sky
put all the triangles together as Peaks

Studio setup, take two. The two mics belong together, so group Mic1 and Mic2 as Mics. Mixer goes below Mics, Lamp left of Mics, and the Sofa in the bottom right corner. How many groups are there, just the one?
ungroup Pair2
Hanoi puzzle. Treat the discs as a stack: group Disc1, Disc2 and Disc3 as Stack. Put Stack right of Peg1 and bring Stack to the front. Peg2 should be near Stack. What groups do we have?
ER layout. Add Bed3 to Beds. Then align Beds horizontally, distribute Beds horizontally too, and make Beds a bit bigger. Triage goes left of Beds. Desk below Beds.

Orchestra seating. Put Strings left of Winds and Drum below Winds. Hmm, actually add Drum to Winds, whatever, the conductor can sort it out. List the members of Winds afterwards. Make Strings and Winds both teal.

Inventory screen for my RPG. The Sword and the Shield are equipment, so make a group Gear with them. Potion and Map are items. Group those two as Items. Which group is Potion in? Then bring Gear to the front and send Items to the back.
Classroom: bundle Pupil1, Pupil2 and Pupil3 into Class. Teach above Class, Board right of Class. Is Teach part of any group? Now delete Class, the school year is over.

Making crepes. Put Egg, Milk and Flour together as Batter. Move Batter 80 pixels down into the bowl... no, put Batter near Bowl. Copy Batter once, we are making two batches. Pan goes right of Bowl. what's in Batter?
group X1 and X2 as Left and X3 and X4 as Right
group M, N and O
Dashboard mock. Make one unit of Chart1 and Chart2, call it Top. Make another unit of Chart3 and Filter and name it Side. Put Side right of Top. How many groups, and what is in Side?
Floral arrangement. Group the red circles as Reds? Actually group all the pink stars as Pinks and put the Vase below Pinks. Is the Rose in a group yet?

Restaurant plan, version 3. Make the indoor rooms a group: Kitchen, Bar and Hall as Indoor. Patio and Cellar are outdoor and underground so no group for them. Move Indoor to the center and Patio below Indoor. Cellar can go at the bottom left. Delete Indoor? no wait I mean duplicate Indoor to test a second floor.
Combine J1, J2 and J3 as Joints and keep the Grip separate. I want Joints in a column, so arrange Joints as a column, and label Grip 'claw'.
Snack bar corner: group Popcorn and Soda as Snacks. Set Snacks to orange, enlarge Snacks, and put Seat below Snacks.
Study plan. Stem is Math and Physics: group them as Stem. Humanities is Poetry and Art, group them as Arts. Put Stem left of Arts. Which group is Art in? Make Stem blue and Arts pink.
PC build. Cpu, Gpu and Ram should be one block called Core. Put that block above Fan. Hmm, bring Core to the front.
Landing page. Add Hero to Nav, call it a day. What's in Nav now?
history timeline. group E1, E2 and E3 as Early. group E4 and E5 as Late. Late goes right of Early. Distribute Early and Late horizontally.
all switches in one group please: group Sw1, Sw2 and Sw3 as Switches, then connect Fw to Sw1, Sw2 and Sw3. Is the Fw in a group? Put Fw above Switches.
Reception hall. Group the tables, Tab1 Tab2 Tab3, as Tables. Spread Tables evenly, vertical. Dj in the center.
Put the Cow, the Pig and the Hen into a group called Animals. Barn at the bottom. Animals above Barn. How many groups is that, just one?
Spreadsheet sketch. Add Row3 to Table. Header above Table. Set Table to green and enlarge Table. What's in Table? make sure Row3 is in.
put Aa and Bb together
add Ee to Pair
list the members of Sky

We are moving offices and I'm redrawing. Are there any groups on the canvas, I can't remember? If not, put Desk and Chair together as Workstation. The Plant goes left of Workstation and Lamp right of it. Also is Lamp part of a group?
Bedtime story map. Put Bear and Bunny in a group named Friends and leave Fox alone. Move Friends near Tree, shrink Friends and color Friends yellow. Which group is Fox in? None, i guess.
Mine layout. group Cart and Rail together as Line. Duplicate Line twice. Align Line vertically. Lamp near Pit.
Gym floor plan. Bundle Bike and Treadmill as Cardio, and Weights stays alone. Put Cardio left of Weights. Make Cardio larger, hmm, huge. What groups are there?
Harbor. Treat Ship1 and Ship2 and Ship3 as a fleet, name it Fleet. Crane above Dock. Move Fleet 200 pixels left, then arrange Fleet in a row. Bring Dock to the back.
Team reshuffle. Add Bo, Cy and Di to Team, all three. Make Team huge and label Team 'All hands'.
Ring topology. Ungroup Ring for a sec and tell me which group A1 is in, I just want to be sure that worked. Then regroup A1 and A2 as RingA, and B1 and B2 as RingB.
Toolbar. Group Btn1, Btn2 and Btn3 as Bar. Align Bar horizontally and distribute Bar horizontally. Label Bar 'tools'. Put Label below Bar.
constellation. combine S1 and S2 as Twins, and combine S3 and S4 as Pair.
